scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/server build && bun run --cwd apps/electron build
scripts.package:win: bun run build && bun run build:server:executable && bun run --cwd apps/electron package:win
scripts.package:win:dir: bun run build && bun run build:server:executable && bun run --cwd apps/electron package:win:dir
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/app typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/electron typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/electron/dist packages/*/dist
